import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('faa_active_civil_airmen_2025.xlsx', sheet_name='T5', header=None)
# Central region states are between row 11 and 16 (index 10 to 15)
central_states = ['Iowa', 'Kansas', 'Kentucky', 'Missouri', 'Nebraska', 'Tennessee']
sub_df = df[df[0].isin(central_states)][[0, 1]].copy()
sub_df[1] = pd.to_numeric(sub_df[1])
top3 = sub_df.sort_values(by=1, ascending=False).head(3)
result = top3[0].tolist()

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('faa_active_civil_airmen_2025.xlsx', sheet_name='T7', header=None)
# Column B (index 1) is 2025
private_total = df[df[0].str.strip().str.startswith('Private--Total', na=False)][1].values[0]
comm_total = df[df[0].str.strip().str.startswith('Commercial--Total', na=False)][1].values[0]
result = 'yes' if float(comm_total) > float(private_total) else 'no'

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('faa_active_civil_airmen_2025.xlsx', sheet_name='T9', header=None)
# Row 7 (index 6) has Total--All Pilots instrument ratings by region
headers = df.iloc[5].tolist()
totals = df.iloc[6].tolist()
# Columns C to J are FAA regions (Alaskan, Central, Eastern, Great Lakes, Northwest Mountain, Southern, Southwest, Western-Pacific)
region_data = list(zip(headers[2:10], totals[2:10]))
region_data.sort(key=lambda x: float(x[1]), reverse=True)
result = region_data[0][0]

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('faa_active_civil_airmen_2025.xlsx', sheet_name='T12', header=None)
# Age groups for 2025 are in column A (index 0) and Total in column B (index 1)
age_groups = ['60-64', '65-69', '70-74', '75-79', '80 and over']
sub_df = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip().isin(age_groups)]
result = int(sub_df[1].astype(int).sum())
